summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a (ControlType, str) member in ControlCode. rich/control.py adds the format entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and Control.title(title). rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title) -> bool, gated on is_terminal like show_cursor, with no Windows calls. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one legacy branch calling term.set_title(title). CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title (skipped on Windows), test_control_title, and test_control_set_window_title (Windows-only, mocked). Tests were not run and Black was not run, per instructions; formatting was checked by reading only. Nothing committed.
